components.name: Round turret/window host
components.function: Need irregular stone/fort-wall returns, cylindrical tower-wall window bands, cone roof seats, stair-to-terrace corners and climbing-rose attachment layout. Source roofs, rose relief, pink masonry and banners already supply detail vocabulary. Pollinators/robins inhabit planted ledges. Provide missing isolated hosts and join views.
components.construction: One isolated round turret/window host matching the supplied building, its roof/arch/wall silhouette and local materials. Show front and interior/rear/underside contact, not a complete building scene. Actual open column galleries and holes stay open. Extend hidden depth only enough to form a joinable section; no palace-wide plan or added unrelated tower.
components.attachment_face: Underside/root to ground or declared host; keep true openings clear
components.semantic_front: Main visible face +Y and Zup; sides are actual thickness, not flattened painting
components.design_basis: Visible source vocabulary with missing construction views or new habitat forms; metrics and hidden surfaces proposed
